Subject: Nexa MAP: benchmark checkpoint — latency & throughput status + next steps

Hello Emily / team,

Quick weekly MAP checkpoint focused on the performance runs we completed last week. Attached are the summarized artifacts (latency_report_v3.pdf and throughput_runs.csv) and a short summary below.

Summary highlights (staging environment; 8 x A100-equivalent):
- Baseline (v1 model config): p95 latency = 220 ms; average throughput = 420 tokens/sec.
- Tuned runtime (continuous batching + kernel swap + int8 quant): p95 latency = 185 ms (16% drop); average throughput = 640 tokens/sec (+52%).
- Notable variance: long-context prompts (>1k tokens) still see p95 spikes ~420 ms; KV cache hit rate currently ~72% on replay traffic in staging.

Actions we recommend for the next sprint:
1) Enable prefix/KV caching for canonical prompt families (owner: neha.kapoor) — target: +10% effective throughput.
2) Canary a quantized model (int8) on 10% of traffic with automated rollback (owner: marcus.lin) — provide playbook and runbook.
3) End-to-end evaluation against your production prompt set (owner: monica.patel) — check fidelity and hallucination regression.
4) SLA alignment: propose p95 <= 200 ms for core flows; customer acceptance gating step in MAP (owner: jasmine.liu).

Proposed next meeting: Thu 2026-12-02 10:00 PT — 30 minutes to review canary plan and staging eval results. I'll send an invite after I hear availability.

Links/attachments: Drive folder with raw traces; latency_report_v3.pdf (summary charts); throughput_runs.csv (per-run traces).

Thanks,
Jasmine Liu
